author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh river trout, open fire, and the calm of nature — this is rustic cooking at its finest 🐟🌾 In this video, we prepare trout over an open flame using simple techniques that bring out its natural flavor.

The fish cooks gently over the fire, developing a light smoky aroma with a crispy skin and tender, juicy meat inside. With minimal ingredients, the true taste of fresh trout shines through in every bite.

This is pure countryside cooking — fresh catch, open fire, and no unnecessary steps. A simple, honest way to enjoy food just as it’s meant to be: natural, flavorful, and deeply satisfying.
title: Rustic Cooking – River Trout Over an Open Flame 🐟🌾
